question: Start ideation for a bounded test of overall-skill Before/After comparison value?

artifacts.summary: Recommend starting ideation only: define a user question and representative whole-skill task, compare added decision value against change-focused scenarios, reuse suitable saved evidence, and predeclare support/refutation criteria. No product feature, exhaustive simulator, live runs or private evidence publication is authorized. Supported, unsupported and inconclusive are all valid outcomes.
